recorded.prompt:q-age-after-repair: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-age-after-repair: From s+d it is "rho(a + (s + d - y0)) + (y - s - d)": 0.5 x 42 = 21 in 2029, so 22 in 2030.
recorded.prompt:q-end-of-horizon: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-end-of-horizon: "A start in 2030 finishes in 2031 and removes no risk inside the plan"; the plan-years column shows 0.
recorded.prompt:q-risk-objective: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-risk-objective: "The model is lesson 6.4.2's, whole, with only the objective's coefficients replaced: rr_{i,t} where lesson 6.4.2 had npv_{i,t}." The rows stay the same and only the objective changes.
